Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 OBJECTIVE 2 GAMEPLAY (per year) 3 ACTIONS 4 SCORING (after year 13) OBJECTIVE Lead your winery to success over 13 years (rounds). Collect points through produced wines, used resources, and a cleverly planned wine tour. GAMEPLAY (per year) Each player has a scoring sheet and 3 workers . A worker is available if their row is empty for the current year. Determine Region & Resource: The leader of the year determines which wine region (L, R, or E) and which resource (C, V, or T) is available to all players. Choose Actions: Everyone plays simultaneously. Per year, you can assign a maximum of one worker to Viticulture and one to Resources . Enter the letter of the action (e.g., "R" for Right Bank) 1, 2, or 3 times into the row of an available worker. Duration: More letters represent stronger actions (e.g., more valuable/aged wines) but block the worker for the following years. Passing: If a 3rd worker is available, they must pass (indicated by entering "-"). ACTIONS Make Wine: Circle a wine in the current region. Longer actions (RR instead of R) allow for more valuable wines. Connect the wine to your existing collection using paths. Gain Resources: Casks (C): Required to be able to produce certain types of wine. Vines (V): Fill the track from left to right. Filling certain spaces allows you to immediately circle a bonus wine for free. Trellises (T): Complete full rows to unlock permanent end-game bonus points (e.g., extra points per white wine). SCORING (after year 13) Add up your points from the following categories: Wine Tour: 1 point per completed path segment between your wines. Longest Tour: 3 bonus points for the longest continuous path. Casks: 1 point per used cask (+3 points for having used the most casks). Trellises: Points from the unlocked bonus rows. Leader Bonus: 1 point if you were the leader less often than others. [Rating: 5/10] A roll and write where active player get to choose either a direction, l/r/center, or a resource, cask - used to circle wines/vines - bonus actions/trellises - end game. Players than pick a wine (e/l/r)/direction/strength (1-3) and circle it on their board, causing this color to take that many turn to reset, same with casks/vines/trellises. After 13 turns, the player with the most points wins, with end game points (trellises) and longest link of circled wins.

[Rating: 5/10] Not many meaningful choices. I hit pretty high scores after a couple plays and it doesn’t feel like there’s room to grow and improve here with further plays. I love the concept of pencil-only book of sheets but I wanted more crunchiness.

[Rating: 5.5/10] Interesting concept for just being a pad of paper. I like that each sheet is its own unique board. I don't think it was executed that great, but it is a fun idea. Not really a game I would want to play often.

[Rating: 5.7/10] pencil writing, network building and working placement game easy to teach but lacks a bit interaction

[Rating: 6/10] Interesting how they took Fromage and made a pencil and paper game.  I can seem the similarities but it feels more restrictive because the rotation always stays the same over multiple games.  There is not change of sheet. Maybe there will be expansion to change it up.
